Klasse GameUtils.Combat

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.GameUtils.Combat
Umschließende Klasse:
GameUtils
public static class GameUtils.Combat extends Object
Collection of helper methods related to combats.

This collections includes to get the best placement for an attack, to calculate the strength of an enemy Nodes or to get the best Nodes to retreat from the enemy.

  • Methodendetails

    • getBestNodeToRunAway

      public static Node getBestNodeToRunAway(List<Node> ring, GameModel gm)
      Returns the best Node to run away with.

      The method prefers neutral nodes not visible to the enemy with the greatest distance to an enemy node.

      If no neutral invisible node exists, it falls back to visible neutral nodes with the greatest distance to an enemy.

      Parameter:
      ring - a list of Nodes forming the ring
      gm - the current GameModel
      Gibt zurück:
      a Node that is considered the best Nodes to run away or null if no Nodes was found

    • getBestPlacement

      public static int getBestPlacement(Node enemyNode, GameModel gm)
      Calculates the best index to place Fernies to attack a given enemy Node.

      The method considers the neighborhood of the given enemy node. It applies a heuristic decision process based on:

      • whether neighboring nodes are neutral or owned by the enemy,
      • the combined strength of the enemy and its neighbors,
      • the visibility,
      • the distance to other enemy nodes.
      Border nodes are preferred, since they absorb the enemy's Fernies.

      If no good placement was found, as a fallback action, the given enemy node gets attacked directly.

      Parameter:
      enemyNode - the enemy Node that gets attacked
      gm - the current GameModel representing the game state
      Gibt zurück:
      the index of the Node where the Fernies to attack the enemy node should be placed

    • getEnemyStrengthWithNeighbours

      public static int getEnemyStrengthWithNeighbours(Node enemyNode, GameModel gm)
      Returns the strength of the given node calculated as a sum of its own Fernies amount plus the number of Fernies of its direct neighbors.
      Parameter:
      enemyNode - given enemy Node
      gm - GameModel which provides the ring as list of nodes
      Gibt zurück:
      the total amount of the Fernies as the strength including the Fernies of both direct neighbors

    • enemySeesNode

      public static boolean enemySeesNode(Node node, List<Node> ring, int absVis)
      Returns whether a given node is visible for the enemy.
      Parameter:
      node - given reference Node to check if it is visible for the enemy
      ring - list of Nodes forming the ring
      absVis - absolute visibility of the match
      Gibt zurück:
      true if a given Node is visible for at least on enemy node, otherwise returns false

    • getNearestEnemy

      public static Node getNearestEnemy(Node n, List<Node> ring)
      Returns the nearest enemy in reference to a given node.
      Parameter:
      n - reference Node for which the nearest enemy should be found
      ring - list of Nodes thats representing the current ring
      Gibt zurück:
      the enemy node with the closest distance to the given node or null if no enemy is found
